FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Faction Colors
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds ability to set apparel colors for faction pawns.

patchNoteLines.li: Can set primary and secondary faction colors in the faction customize menu
Can set individual apparel colors for military units in the Manage Units menu

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Squad Deployment Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with squad deployment.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: squads that are deployed to a map, and then told to leave, will not actually enter cooldown, leaving their settlement stuck in a "Deployed" state

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New color picker
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a new color picker window to compliment the faction color settings.
